class.name: SpatialInventoryStaging
class.brief_description: Holds items temporarily and remembers their original placements.
class.description: A tray can return all its staged items as one checked operation. If the return fails, the tray retains the items.

members.member: Optional callback that receives the item and source placement before an item is picked up. Return an empty String to allow the pickup or a reason to deny it. Defaults to an empty callable.

Optional callback that receives the item and proposed destination placement, including a placement in its original grid during restoration. Return an empty String to allow it or a reason to deny it. Defaults to an empty callable.
Optional callback that receives all proposed placement changes before the tray restores its contents. Return an empty String to allow the batch or a reason to deny it. Defaults to an empty callable.
The tray's own grid. It exists before configuration. Use staging operations to move items so the tray can track their original placements.
Reason reported by the most recent failed staging operation. An operation that succeeds clears the reason.
